findings.issue: The four price functions return only through 'return memory from mem[64] len _N - mem[64]' (all 8 of their returns): each arm writes the values at a different memory position and the return reads the phi, so the returned price and timestamp never appear in a return statement.
findings.rule: When the arms of a branch leave the return buffer at different places, duplicate the return into each arm (or name the phi of mem[64] per arm) so each arm's return resolves to its words: 'return _23, uint48(block.timestamp)'.

notes: Unoptimized build. All 39 ABI functions reviewed; the long ones (addAsset 1320 lines, updateAsset 2180, getPriceIn x2 1240/1360, validateUpdateAsset 730, storeObservation(s)) by structure. removeAsset was checked line by line (permissioned via kernel.modulePermissions, unit-of-account and approved checks, the swap-and-pop loop, the field-by-field delete of the Asset struct with the obs array cleared as a copy line and the two bytes members cleared with their Panic(34) encoding checks, AssetRemoved): exact. Loops: 9 explicit, all shown as whiles: removeAsset's search, storeObservations' loop over assets, ensureValidSubKeycode (i < 20, in 4 submodule functions), _getFeedPrices, _getInclusivePrices, _updateAssetMovingAverage, _validateAssetMovingAverage, and _validateAssetPriceFeeds' outer and inner loops (inner aborted only in updateAsset). Implicit: abi.decode of Component[] from storage bytes (readable whiles), solc's checked 10 ** _decimals helper ('while u > 1', 17 copies, readable), getSubmodules/getAssets storage-to-memory copies printed rotated (P3, 164, 190) and 15 memory-to-memory copies as whiles (P7). Parameter names from the signature DB mislead in places (removeAsset(address _nftContract)), which is normal. The 29 P2 lines and the raw custom-error reverts have the same cause as in c00585 (a named read of mem[64] not unified with later reads). No execution run.
summary: Faithful where complete and the loops are all present, but the four price getters return only through raw memory reads of a phi buffer, and updateAsset loses its whole update-and-emit tail when two or more feeds are given.
